C9000337.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 337 (Sharp Cartan–Hadamard isoperimetry and rigidity.; papers: Generalized Cartan–Hadamard isoperimetry and Euclidean equality rigidity; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/337.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_EXTRINSIC_SOB.statement: For every m>=3 locally C^{1,1} immersed hypersurface in a complete simply connected ambient manifold of Sec<=-b^2, b=0 or 1, Q(v)>=m|S^m|^{2/m}||v||_{2m/(m-2)}^2 for all compactly supported interior Lipschitz tests and zero extensions from H^1_0(U). No completeness, connectedness or orientability of the hypersurface is assumed.

L_MAPS.statement: The radial map differential and logarithmic Hessian estimates imply the completed comparison square with the stated signs and coefficients.

L_BALANCE.statement: Every compactly supported nonatomic probability measure admits finite center and scale parameters giving zero mean for all comparison-map coordinates.

L_ATTAIN.statement: The locally Lipschitz induced metric and bounded potential have the Euclidean concentration threshold, and a Dirichlet quotient strictly below it is attained on every relatively compact open U without boundary regularity.

L_VARIATION.statement: Balanced coordinate multiplier variations of a subthreshold minimizer, combined with the comparison square, force grad psi=((m-2)/2)psi grad u almost everywhere.

L_ZERO_EXT.statement: The H^1_0(U) zero extension of e^{-((m-2)/2)u}psi has zero weak gradient, and vanishes on an open complement, contradicting nonzero mass on a connected component.

L_SCOPE.statement: Point-capacity cutoffs, finite component summation and H^1_0 approximation extend the connected proper-support result to exactly the manuscript's full scope.

L_MASS_CLOSURE.statement: For real p<=1 and 0<=Y<B, the critical mass inequality Y*t^p+B*(1-t)^p<=Y on 0<=t<=1 forces t=1; positive-coefficient coordinate and square inequalities force zero defect.

L_VECTOR_TRACE.statement: For arbitrary codimension, with H=-trace(II)/m and beta=(grad_g u)^normal, the weak restriction formula and tangential trace complete m|H+beta|^2, so the same comparison square holds without a codimension-dependent coefficient.

C_CODIM_SOB.statement: For every m>=3 locally C^{1,1} immersion into a complete simply connected Sec<=-b^2 ambient manifold of any dimension n>=m, the same sharp Sobolev inequality holds with h^2 replaced by the squared normalized mean-curvature vector, in the full interior-support and H^1_0 scope.

C_CONFINED_REG.statement: Ghomi-Spruck v7 Lemma 7.2(i),(ii) supplies interior and obstacle regularity independently of the total-curvature assumption.

C_MAIN_COMPARISON.statement: The manuscript's all-dimensional finite-volume finite-perimeter comparison theorem; downstream of the present Sobolev mission and not certified here.

C_EQUALITY_RIGIDITY.statement: The manuscript's bounded finite-perimeter Euclidean equality classification; downstream of the present Sobolev mission and not certified here.

D_PROFILE.statement: The confined-profile curvature bounds and differential inequality integrate to the exact model comparison; this downstream obligation is not audited in this mission.

D_SINGULAR_CUTOFF.statement: The confined minimizers have the area-growth and vanishing-energy singular cutoffs needed for the constant Sobolev test; this downstream obligation is not audited here.

D_FINITE_SCOPE.statement: The classical low-dimensional inputs, strict BV approximation, finite-volume exhaustion and metric scaling preserve the complete comparison theorem's scope; this downstream obligation is not audited here.

D_EQUALITY_REGULARITY.statement: A bounded equality set has the claimed global regularity, common constant mean curvature, and admissible singular cutoffs; this downstream obligation is not audited here.

D_RIGIDITY.statement: Equality forces the entire equality region, not only its boundary, to be isometric to a Euclidean ball; this downstream obligation is not audited here.
